what: Photos, videos and color planes inside a section are drawn as panels on one screen-fixed canvas instead of the DOM, and that canvas is laid over the whole screen once more so it bends outward horizontally toward the bottom edge of the screen (bell shape) — uv.x += (2x−1)·strength·−.05·(1−y)^distance (default 34, a little under 6% from the bottom of the screen). Photos and color blocks rising with scroll unfold with their bottom edge dropping from the floor. When a section comes within 25% outside the screen, the panel lights up in .25s, and the text inside it (data-fx-part=text) turns on .1s later, at .3s
ease: none (pinned in place on screen) · on state linear

options.distance: How concentrated the bend is (power of (1−y)), default 34 — the smaller it is, the further up the screen it bends
options.strength: Bend strength (multiples of .05), default 1 — at the very bottom of the screen the panel spreads 5% to each side
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Slot for a photo or video drawn on the panel — if there is an img or video inside, that picture is used (cover fit), otherwise a placeholder is drawn with the slot’s background and line color and data-label
options.[data-fx-part=fill]: Color area to paint as the panel (the cell’s background-color)
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Text laid over the board — raised with z-index 2 and appears after the board turns on

use:
…

 — One stage per page, attached to each section. three.cjs is loaded between scroll-sag-warp/three-pre.js·three-post.js
note: The original warps the whole-screen uv with an Effect from pmndrs postprocessing (Zlib). The part rewrites the same formula with a three render target plus a single full-screen shader. As in the original, on touch screens (no hover) or reduced-motion settings it builds no stage and leaves the DOM photos as they are. The planes are built from the children at first draw, so photo slots added later must get data-fx again to be drawn.

from.where: shared.js · index.html case row · news cards · footer video, detail.html photo section — original ExperienceController (three r177 + CurveEffect distance 34 · strength 1)
